results.description: Sets the probation end date to 6 months after hire for permanent employees in Germany.

conditions.if: Job Information.Event Reason = 'Hire' AND Job Information.Country = 'DEU' AND Job Information.Employee Type = 'Permanent'
then: Set Job Information.Probation Period End Date to AddMonths(Job Information.Start Date, 6)

conditions.if: Job Information.Event Reason = 'Hire' AND Job Information.Employee Type = 'Fixed Term'
then: Set Job Information.Probation Period End Date to AddMonths(Job Information.Start Date, 3)
Raise Message 'Probation shortened for fixed-term contract'

conditions.if: Compensation Information.Total Annual Salary > Pay Range.Maximum
then: Raise Message 'Salary exceeds the pay range maximum' (Severity: Error)

conditions.if: Compensation Information.Total Annual Salary < Pay Range.Minimum
then: Raise Message 'Salary below the pay range minimum' (Severity: Warning)

results.conditions: Set Badge Request.Status to 'New'; Execute Rule JI_Default_Probation_End
